description.en: Finds an ICAO MRZ in a document photo, validates every required check digit, and returns attributes only when validation succeeds.
description.de: Findet die ICAO-MRZ in einem Dokumentfoto, prüft alle erforderlichen Prüfziffern und gibt Attribute nur nach erfolgreicher Prüfung zurück.
description.zh: 从证件照片中查找 ICAO MRZ，验证所有必需校验位，仅在验证成功后返回属性。

params.prologue: Загрузите фотографию документа. Я верну данные MRZ только после успешной проверки всех обязательных контрольных цифр.

params.description: Locates and transcribes an ICAO 9303 machine-readable zone from a document image.
params.sys_prompt: You are an OCR stage, not a document-data extraction stage. Locate the machine-readable zone (MRZ) in the image and transcribe it character-for-character. Allowed characters are A-Z, 0-9 and <. Never repair a check digit, infer a missing character, replace a character to make validation pass, or return fields printed outside the MRZ. Preserve every filler < and exact line length. Supported layouts are TD1 (3 lines of 30), TD2 (2 lines of 36), and TD3 (2 lines of 44). Return JSON only, exactly in this shape: {"mrz_lines":["..."]}. If no complete MRZ is visible or any character is unreadable, return {"mrz_lines":[]}.
